expects.rule: The first screen says what is made or done and for which industries, in plain words (e.g. 'technical industrial dry ice cleaning'), not only a vision statement.
Industries or applications are a visible entry point in the menu, so a buyer can start from their sector.
Technical documents (data sheets, safety data sheets, CAD files, manuals) are reachable without a sales call; gating is limited to marketing content.
One clear business action (request a quote, site visit, talk to an engineer) repeated at the end of each section, with a direct phone or email for a named team or site.
Proof is specific: figures with units, named customers or case studies, certifications with their standard (ISO 9001 etc.), real plant and product photographs.
Each country or language version states which entity, address and company number it belongs to.

traits: 5 of 7 list industries or segments in the main menu or on the home page (Cryox, Q-Industrial, Carbo, Aalberts, Rondo by product family); Vegusa organises by equipment type and Nexus by software product.

4 of 7 open with a short functional headline (Cryox 'Technical industrial dry ice cleaning', Q-Industrial 'Industrial / Coatings', Vegusa product slides, Nexus customer portal); Carbo, Aalberts and Rondo open with a mission sentence, a featured story or a support promise.
3 of 7 give a phone number on the home page (Cryox 24/7 line in the footer, Carbo near the footer, Vegusa seven branch numbers in the header plus WhatsApp); the others route to a contact page.

Technical documents are reachable from 3 of 7 (Rondo manuals and CAD DXF files, Carbo data sheets in Resources, Q-Industrial formulas behind a login); Carbo also gates articles behind a name-email-phone form.

4 of 7 use real photographs of work or plant (Cryox operators in protective suits, Q-Industrial spray painting and locomotives, Aalberts buildings and staff, Rondo support staff); all 7 were read as page text, not screenshots.

sites.name: CRYOX
sites.why: Belgian dry ice cleaning contractor: headline 'Technical industrial dry ice cleaning', menu of four items plus NL/EN, 'schedule a site visit' repeated through the page, five benefits (no water, non-abrasive, safe for electrics), a four-step process, seven sectors, photographs of operators in protective suits, 24/7 phone and company number in the footer.

sites.name: Q-Industrial
sites.why: Industrial paint and coatings maker, English (Germany) and Ukrainian versions: headline 'Industrial / Coatings', menu of Industries (5), Surfaces (5), Catalog and a locked Technologies section, Explore Catalog button, five sector cards (rail, machine tools, metal structures), photographs of spray painting and freight locomotives, 'Consult with our experts' footer action.

sites.name: CARBO
sites.why: Ceramic proppants and industrial media maker: headline on ceramic solutions for global industries, menu with Industries (oil and gas, foundry, mining, geothermal) and Resources (technical and safety data sheets), figures (110+ patents, 45 years, 17 countries), case studies, phone and Houston address in a closing contact block; some articles gated behind a form.

sites.name: Rondo
sites.why: Australian maker of steel ceiling and wall framing: headlines on technical design support, Find a Supplier in header and footer, product families in the menu, links to product manuals, whitepapers, CAD DXF drawings and safety data sheets (by request), Australia/New Zealand switch, photograph of support staff.

sites.name: Vegusa Maquinaria
sites.why: Mexican forklift and machinery dealer: branch selector with seven cities, seven phone numbers in the header, floating WhatsApp button with pre-filled New, Used and Rental messages, hero slides with a priced truck ('Desde $590,900*'), four service cards (new, used, rental, parts), 14-question FAQ, branch addresses with map links.

sites.name: Hexagon Nexus
sites.why: Customer portal for Hexagon manufacturing software: heading 'Welcome to the Customer Portal', tagline 'The Future of Manufacturing is Open', Register for free and Login buttons, a grid of ten product tiles (EDGECAM, PC-DMIS, RADAN Quoting), a three-slide carousel (academy, metrology shop), five tagged news items. No contact form.

avoid: A home page headline that is a mission statement with no product, process or industry named.
Data sheets and safety sheets hidden behind a sales form or a 'request' button.
Prices shown with an asterisk and no footnote anywhere on the page.
Placeholder content left live: '000-000-0000' phone numbers, 'Image Alt Text Here', unlabelled hero images.
Figures without units or context (a total in pounds with no period or product).
Award pages that still link to a lapsed company domain now used by an unrelated site; check before citing.
Contact limited to a generic form when a 24/7 or per-site phone number exists.
